note: Governance as code with signed evidence artifacts and clause level traceability across EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
title: From Policy to Pipeline: A Governance Framework for AI Development and Operations Pipelines
explain_beginner: This paper presents a new system for ensuring artificial intelligence applications follow important rules and laws. Rather than checking compliance after a system is built, this approach weaves rules directly into the development process itself. The system automatically collects evidence at each stage of building and running AI, creates tamper-proof records, and proves that regulations like the EU AI Act are being followed. Using a hospital early-warning system as an example, the authors show this makes AI development more transparent, trustworthy, and accountable.
explain_business: This framework reduces compliance risk by embedding regulatory requirements directly into development pipelines rather than relying on manual, retrospective auditing. Organizations gain automatically generated audit evidence and can demonstrate accountability across multiple regulations simultaneously. The approach accelerates time-to-market by eliminating manual compliance documentation work while increasing confidence in high-risk deployments. For regulated industries like healthcare and finance, this provides deterministic proof of compliance and significantly reduces legal exposure when regulations are contested or audited.
explain_practitioner: GEAP implements governance as executable code integrated into ML pipelines across five control gates: Data, Training, Validation, Release, and Operations. Each gate generates signed, content-addressed artifacts stored in an Evidence Backbone. The framework automatically maps these artifacts to specific regulatory clauses across EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001 through deterministic traceability, eliminating manual documentation. Governance metrics quantify adequacy, completeness, stability, and evidence quality. A sepsis detection system case study validates that GEAP enforces promotion policies, detects violations, and produces audit-ready compliance bundles automatically.
